events.name: Mo Amer
events.info: Blue Note Comedy Series Mo Amer Don't miss your chance to see global comedy powerhouse Mohammed "Mo" Amer live on stage for his unstoppable El Oso Palestino Tour! Fresh off the hit second season of his acclaimed Netflix series MO---a Peabody and Gotham Award-winning sensation boasting a rare 100% Rotten Tomatoes rating---Mo brings his signature hilarious storytelling directly to you. From starring in Netflix specials like Wild World and Hulu's Ramy, to sharing the big screen with Dwayne Johnson in DC's Black Adam and earning GQ UAE's 'Man of the Year', this world-class comedian has captivated audiences in over 40 countries. Tickets are moving fast for an unforgettable night of high-energy, award-winning stand-up, so lock in your seats now before they sell out! Ticket Prices $35-$45 __________________________________________ CLUB POLICIES Show 6:30pm & 9pm Doors 5pm & 8:30pm Seating is First Come, First Served Per Section $20 Minimum Per Person Full Bar & Dinner Menu Available NO REFUNDS OR EXCHANGES. Tickets will be delivered 48 hours prior to the showtime. Please ensure you purchase tickets for the correct date and time. When all available Bar Seats are occupied, the remaining Bar Area is standing room only. Table Seating is All Ages, Bar Area is 21+. IMPORTANT NOTE: We are NOT affiliated with ANY third-party ticket sellers! Tickets purchased directly through our official website or TicketWeb are the ONLY authorized sources. GROUP RESERVATIONS: Groups of 6 or more that want to sit together must purchase a group package at events@bluenotehawaii.com. PARKING: Validated parking available at OUTRIGGER Paradise. Entrance located on Kuhio Ave. $6 for up to 4 hours of parking.
events.pleaseNote: This event is 18 and over. Any ticket holder unable to present valid identification indicating that they are at least 18 years of age will not be admitted to this event, and will not be eligible for a refund. For parties of 6 or more please call us at 808-777-4898 to book! We do not offer any refunds, exchanges, or transfers on any ticket purchases. All sales are final. We do not have any liability or influence on tickets purchased through a ticket reselling or 3rd party site. Official ticket purchases are run through TicketWeb.com only.

events.name: Tank and The Bangas
events.info: Tank and the BangasFor Tank and the Bangas, music is a vessel for unbridled joy and transcendent connectionforces as integral to their essence as their wildly original sound. On their new album The Last Balloon, the New Orleans-bred outfit channel those impulses into something celebratory yet profoundly human, exploring themes of frustration, resilience, and self-realization with equal parts raw emotionality and playful exuberance. A shapeshifting collective helmed by lead singer Tarriona Tank Ball and multi-instrumentalist Norman Spence II, the globally beloved group completed the LP after winning a GRAMMY for 2024s spoken-word powerhouse The Heart, The Mind, The Soul, moving from incendiary poetry to a euphoric collision of soul and hip-hop and forward-thinking Rs Green Balloon (a critical triumph that earned them a GRAMMY nomination for Best New Artist), The Last Balloon ultimately solidifies Tank and the Bangas legacy as one of modern musics most steadfast voices of sublime exhilaration.Tickets $30-$40__________________________________________CLUB POLICIESShow 6:30pm & 9pmDoors 5pm & 8:30pmSeating is First Come, First Served Per Section$20 Minimum Per PersonFull Bar & Dinner Menu AvailableNO REFUNDS OR EXCHANGES.Tickets will be delivered 48 hours prior to the showtime.Please ensure you purchase tickets for the correct date and time.When all available Bar Seats are occupied, the remaining Bar Area is standing room only. venues.name: Neal S Blaisdell Arena

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Address: 777 Ward Avenue, Honolulu, Hawaii 96814 Phone: (808) 768-5252 (events information recording) For Advance Ticket Sales Main Box Office (Arena) Hours: ** Monday - Saturday, 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM **Closed on Sunday and all Holidays unless there is a scheduled event for that day and only that event will be sold For Day of Event Ticket Sales Main Box Office (Arena) Hours: Closed on Sundays, and all Holidays unless there is a scheduled event for that day.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, MC, DSC & Cash. No Checks. ATM located nearby.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will call may be picked up at any window at any time that the box office is open. Customers do not need to wait until the night of the show.

venues.parkingDetail: Cost: Event Parking: Before 5PM: $6.00 After 5PM: $7.00 In/Out Pass: $8.00 (In/Out Good Only For Day of Purchase @ Parking Booth) Non-Event Parking (Daily): $6.00 VIP Parking available for select events : $23.00 Elite VIP Parking: VIP Parking is open for ticket holders only, subject to availability Selected Blaisdell Arena events, please enter off of Ward Ave., South (Makai) of Box Office Selected Concert Hall and Exhibition events, please enter off of Ward Ave. between Exhibition Hall and Concert Hall Note: No left turn permitted on Ward Ave. into driveways Hours of Operation : 1 hour prior to event until end of event time VIP Parking Customer Service: For Elite VIP Parking purchased through Ticketmaster call customer service at 1-877-750-4400 Box Office Parking: Box Office Parking is open for ticket buyers only. Parking for the patrons of the Box Office is free. If Box Office Parking is full, ticket buyers may enter through the King Street Gate. The ticket buyers will be refunded the parking fee after they validate their ticket at the Box Office. King Street Entrance: This is the main entrance to the Blaisdell Parking Lot. The gate opens at 5:30 a.m., Monday through Saturday. The gate closes at 6:00 p.m. on all evenings with no event scheduled. The gate closes 45 minutes after the last event is completed. On Sundays and Holidays, gate operation is determined by events. Kapiolani Entrance: This entrance is closed when there are no events scheduled. Only cardholders can access this gate when it is unattended. Signs are posted to direct non card holders to the King Street entrance. This gate will also be open two hours prior to the opening of all major events scheduled in the central areas and will remain open until the completion of the last event. Hours of Operation: Non-Event Days (Mon thru Fri) 5:30am - 5:00pm Event Days (Mon thru Fri) 5:30am to end of night (event night) Event Days (Weekends & Holidays) 2 Hours prior to start of event to end of night Parking Booths close 45 minutes prior to end of last event.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available in the lower level of Blaisdell Arena. No elevators for upper level or loge seating.
